about: What ui/src/lib/humanize.ts humanizeLog does to each line: the rule that replaces it whole (lane, camera, nina, plate, guid) or null when it reaches the operator as written. Read by server/tests/test_997_humanizer_mirror.py, which holds the Python mirror (server/tests/_humanizer_mirror.py) to it, and by ui/src/lib/__tests__/humanizeRewrites.test.ts, which holds the real function to it. Change a rule in humanize.ts and one side goes red until this file and the mirror agree again. Every line is under CLIP_AT so a line that is kept is kept whole.
